wikipedia:en.title: Salat al-Fatih
wikipedia:en.extract: In Sufism, the Salat al-Fatih (Arabic: صَلَاةُ الْفَاتِحِ, "opener's prayer")  was transmitted to the Muslims by Sheikh Muhammad ibn Abi al-Hasan al-Bakri, a successor of Abu Bakr al-Siddiq later this is  accepted and litany (wird)  prayer for Muhammad practiced individually or in congregation by followers (murids) in the Tijaniyya order.
